tour.title: How to use the Chat tab

step1.title: This is the Chat tab
step1.body: A plain AI chat — ask questions, paste text, attach files or images. No folder or setup needed. Let me show you the three things that matter.

step2.title: Pick where the AI comes from
step2.body: This is the provider picker. "Free" needs no key; others — Venice, Bankr, Ollama, llama.cpp — use a key or a local model. The model list shows capability tags (vision · reasoning · tools) so you grab the right one. Each chat remembers its own provider.

step3.title: Type your message
step3.body: Write here. You can drag in files/images or paste a screenshot. Type "/" to use a skill. Each chat keeps its own memory of the conversation.

step4.title: Send it
step4.body: Press this Send button or hit Enter (Shift+Enter for a new line). The reply streams in above. Start a fresh chat any time with "New".

step5.title: You are set
step5.body: Pick a provider, type, send. The meter up top shows how full the conversation is getting. Reopen this from the "How to" button.
